critic_risk_flags: SEIHR with direct H observation is likely weakly identifiable with only 31 training points in a single season, consistent with the provided risk note. This adds compartmental complexity that can be absorbed by other parameters (e.g., transmission/waning), increasing instability without clear necessity given delayed_I is already plausible.

SEIHR plus I+H observation further increases flexibility and confounding (tradeoffs between I and H contributions) on short data, raising overfitting/identifiability risk. It also weakens interpretability of a hospitalization-rate target by mixing states without strong justification here.
